verdict.rationale: Exa is a search and retrieval API that handles user queries and data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-use policies, training opt-outs, zero-retention modes, or privacy controls over customer data. The robots.txt indexing claim concerns crawling third-party sites, not whether customer data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
